evals.prompt: Break down a behavior-changing spec into llm-mode tasks in English. The spec has AC1 for API contract behavior and FR2 for verification requirements.
evals.expected_output: Each generated task.md Implementation Steps entry includes target file/module, Related AC/FR, Contract / Behavior Change, and Verification Command / Evidence. If a step cannot be traced to a spec outcome, the generated task is treated as not ready rather than silently accepted.

evals.name: architecture-packet-positive
evals.prompt: Use $ywc-task-generator --spec docs/ywc-plans/feature.md --manifest architecture-invariants.json --architecture-evidence .ywc-architecture-invariants-evidence.json with a valid bounded audit.
evals.expected_output: Records a sanitized packet: contract_state VALIDATED, component ownership, rule IDs projected from rule_results, invariant_verdict projected from aggregate_verdict, and the evidence artifact path. Helper status, aggregate verdict, rule results, and evidence paths remain distinct.
expectations: Emits component_ids from the helper bounded changed-path mapping
Does not copy raw evidence, transcripts, command-like fields, or full diffs into task metadata; evidence paths remain bounded citations

evals.name: architecture-packet-no-evidence
evals.prompt: Use $ywc-task-generator --spec docs/ywc-plans/feature.md --manifest architecture-invariants.json without --architecture-evidence.
evals.expected_output: Preserves existing task generation and writes no architecture packet; missing evidence is not converted into VIOLATED.
expectations: No generated README.md contains an `## Architecture Contract Packet` heading
No generated task.md contains an `## Architecture Contract Packet` heading
No placeholder packet fields (Contract State, Component IDs, Rule IDs, Verifier Requirement, Invariant Verdict, Evidence Artifact Path) are emitted

evals.name: architecture-packet-invalid-evidence
evals.prompt: Use $ywc-task-generator --spec docs/ywc-plans/feature.md --manifest architecture-invariants.json --architecture-evidence invalid.json with malformed, unknown, or forbidden evidence fields.
evals.expected_output: Returns NEEDS_CONTEXT before writing preview or task artifacts and does not copy or expose invalid evidence content.

evals.name: architecture-packet-violation
evals.prompt: Use $ywc-task-generator --spec docs/ywc-plans/feature.md --manifest architecture-invariants.json --architecture-evidence forbidden-edge.json where aggregate_verdict is VIOLATED.
evals.expected_output: Projects invariant_verdict VIOLATED and affected rule IDs, surfaces VIOLATED as a task-generation finding, and does not grant task-generator or implementer authority to execute or override gates.

evals.name: non-interactive-context-matrix
evals.prompt: Run non-interactive task generation from a validated final spec with no preview flags involved, while independently omitting --mode or leaving --lang unresolved.

input.accepted: Final DONE spec artifact with an explicit --mode and a resolved language chain
rejected: unresolved --lang after the full resolution chain

evals.expected_status: DONE for the accepted fixture; NEEDS_CONTEXT for every rejected fixture
evals.expected_handoff: accepted only after all deterministic inputs are verified; rejected without task artifact handoff
evals.expected_output: Names the missing or unresolved argument and never prompts or guesses a default. Preview identity is not evaluated on this path because no preview flags are supplied, so a normal non-interactive run is never rejected for absent preview fields.

evals.name: architecture-evidence-without-manifest
evals.prompt: Use $ywc-task-generator --spec docs/ywc-plans/feature.md --architecture-evidence .ywc-architecture-invariants-evidence.json with no --manifest at all.
evals.expected_output: Per SKILL.md Step 5.5, evidence without a valid manifest is NEEDS_CONTEXT. Returns NEEDS_CONTEXT before any artifact write and never falls back to root-only manifest discovery in order to accept the supplied evidence.
expectations: Returns NEEDS_CONTEXT and names the missing --manifest
Creates or writes no preview artifact, no task directories, no dependency-graph.md, and no architecture packet
Does not copy or expose the supplied evidence content in the response

evals.name: approve-preview-identity-mismatch
evals.prompt: Use $ywc-task-generator --spec docs/ywc-plans/billing.md --approve-preview --preview-path docs/ywc-plans/billing.task-preview.md --non-interactive against an approved persisted preview, with exactly one preview identity field missing or mismatched.

input.accepted: Approved preview whose preview_path, preview_revision, preview_digest, spec_path, tasks_dir, lang, and mode all match exactly

evals.expected_status: DONE for the exact-match fixture; NEEDS_CONTEXT for every single-field mismatch
evals.expected_handoff: task artifacts handed off only from the exactly matching approved preview; no handoff on any mismatch
evals.expected_output: Per the Preview Approval Gate, exact preview identity match is required only on the --approve-preview path. Names the specific missing or mismatched identity field, never re-decomposes, never silently refreshes the preview, and writes no task artifacts on mismatch.

evals.name: initials-allocation-contract
evals.prompt: Run non-interactive task generation with explicit --initials yk in a repository with yk and js tasks, completed tasks, dependency-graph entries, and linked worktrees.
evals.expected_output: Resolves and validates initials before any scan. New IDs use yk-000001-010-...; js IDs are ignored for yk allocation, while legacy numeric IDs remain readable. The maximum is taken from graph, active, completed, and corresponding linked-worktree task directories. The selected phase is compare-and-create reserved under refs/ywc/task-phase/yk/<phase> in the repository common Git directory before any artifact write.
expectations: Absolute or escaping --tasks-dir returns NEEDS_CONTEXT before writes
Inaccessible or mismatched linked-worktree sources are reported
A reservation collision retries the next phase and preserves the consumed ref
Legacy directories are not renamed or counted as another namespace

evals.name: missing-initials-before-write
evals.prompt: Run non-interactive generation without --initials and without valid project or user cached initials, with a writable preview path and tasks directory.
evals.expected_output: Names the missing initials and returns NEEDS_CONTEXT before graph compaction, linked-worktree scanning, Git reservation, preview creation, dependency-graph writes, or task-directory creation. The writable artifact locations remain unchanged.
